# Boundary composition inputs

These literal boundary cases belong to the standalone vocabulary composition
catalogue test boundary. They are not proof of compiler/project/codec activation.
See the parent fixture README for ownership and the pinned conformance manifest.

`requests.json` supplies exact and one-over alternative and aggregate dependency
edge caps for the same literal inputs. Other independent source/wire/allocation
budgets remain required by the full validation gate, not inferred from these cases.
